name: application-date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: Input-triggered calendar popover for choosing a single date, driven by a typed day-grid prop contract.
useWhen: A form field needs a single date value chosen from a visual calendar instead of typed free-form text.
You want a compact trigger button that expands into a month grid on demand.
Booking, scheduling, or filtering flows where users pick one specific day.
avoidWhen: Users need to pick a date range — build a two-ended variant instead of reusing single-date selection state.
The date is far in the past or future (e.g. birthdate) — a typed or select-based input is faster than paging months.
You need a persistently visible calendar — use the calendar component directly without the input trigger.
responsiveBehavior: The trigger button is full-width within its container; the calendar popover has a fixed width and should reposition (flip above/below) to stay in the viewport on small screens.
accessibility: The trigger button carries aria-haspopup='dialog' and aria-expanded reflecting the popover's open state.
The popover uses role='dialog' with an aria-label describing its purpose.
The current day uses aria-current='date' and the chosen day uses aria-selected, not color alone.

variants.title: Date Picker
variants.description: Labeled trigger button that opens a month calendar with previous/next navigation, today shortcut, and an apply action.
accessibility: Today and the selected day are distinguished by both a filled background and an aria attribute, not color alone.

variants.title: Date Picker (Dark)
variants.description: Date picker adapted for dark surfaces with the same trigger, month-grid, and action-row structure.
accessibility: Day-grid text and the selected-day fill must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
